web/src/routes/account/recoveryCodes.tsx.name: Recovery codes
web/src/routes/account/recoveryCodes.tsx.description: Issues and shows a person's one-time backup sign-in codes, and keeps the code list in step across the account screens.

web/src/routes/account/SecurityPanel.tsx.name: Account security panel
web/src/routes/account/SecurityPanel.tsx.description: Shows whether two-step sign-in is on and how many backup codes are left, with buttons to make new codes or turn it off.

web/src/routes/account/TwoFactorFlow.tsx.name: Two-step sign-in setup
web/src/routes/account/TwoFactorFlow.tsx.description: Walks someone through turning on two-step sign-in, replacing the account page while it runs so the secret code leaves the screen with the step.

web/src/routes/account/TwoFactorQr.tsx.name: Setup QR code
web/src/routes/account/TwoFactorQr.tsx.description: Draws the QR code for an authenticator app right on the page, so the secret key is never sent as a picture.

web/src/routes/account/useTwoFactor.ts.name: Two-step sign-in logic
web/src/routes/account/useTwoFactor.ts.description: Keeps track of the two-step sign-in section: its status, the setup steps, a warning when backup codes run low, and the password re-check before changes.

web/src/routes/AccountPage.tsx.name: My account page
web/src/routes/AccountPage.tsx.description: Lets any signed-in person change their own password by entering the current one, and hosts the two-step sign-in security section.

web/src/routes/users/ChangeEmailDialog.t.name: Change email pop-up
web/src/routes/users/ChangeEmailDialog.t.description: Pop-up window where an owner changes a staff member's email address.

web/src/routes/users/ChangeRoleDialog.ts.name: Change role pop-up
web/src/routes/users/ChangeRoleDialog.ts.description: Pop-up window where an owner changes what role a staff member has.

web/src/routes/users/CreateUserDialog.ts.name: Add user pop-up
web/src/routes/users/CreateUserDialog.ts.description: Pop-up form for adding a new worker or another admin, after a password re-check.

web/src/routes/users/DisableEnableDialog.name: Disable or enable user pop-up
web/src/routes/users/DisableEnableDialog.description: Pop-up that confirms turning a staff member's account off or back on.

web/src/routes/users/EditUserDialog.tsx.name: Edit user pop-up
web/src/routes/users/EditUserDialog.tsx.description: Pop-up window for changing a staff member's display name.

web/src/routes/users/FlockAccessDialog.t.name: Flock access pop-up
web/src/routes/users/FlockAccessDialog.t.description: Pop-up for choosing which flocks a worker may work with, adding or removing them after a password re-check.

web/src/routes/users/ResetTwoFactorDialo.name: Reset two-step sign-in pop-up
web/src/routes/users/ResetTwoFactorDialo.description: Pop-up where an owner confirms clearing another person's two-step sign-in so they can set it up again.

web/src/routes/users/SetPasswordDialog.t.name: Reset password pop-up
web/src/routes/users/SetPasswordDialog.t.description: Pop-up where an owner sets a new password for a staff member.

web/src/routes/users/useChangeEmail.ts.name: Change email logic
web/src/routes/users/useChangeEmail.ts.description: Holds the form entries and saving steps behind the change-email pop-up.

web/src/routes/users/useChangeRole.ts.name: Change role logic
web/src/routes/users/useChangeRole.ts.description: Holds the choices and saving steps behind the change-role pop-up.

web/src/routes/users/useCreateUser.ts.name: Add user logic
web/src/routes/users/useCreateUser.ts.description: Holds the form entries, opening and closing, and the password-checked save behind the add-user pop-up.

web/src/routes/users/useDisableEnable.ts.name: Disable or enable logic
web/src/routes/users/useDisableEnable.ts.description: Holds the steps behind the pop-up that turns a user's account off or on.

web/src/routes/users/useEditUser.ts.name: Edit user logic
web/src/routes/users/useEditUser.ts.description: Holds the display-name entry and save behind the edit-user pop-up, starting from the current name.

web/src/routes/users/useFlockAccess.ts.name: Flock access logic
web/src/routes/users/useFlockAccess.ts.description: Holds the open and close steps and the password-checked adding and removing of flocks for a worker.

web/src/routes/users/useResetTwoFactor.t.name: Reset two-step sign-in logic
web/src/routes/users/useResetTwoFactor.t.description: Sends the request for an owner to clear another user's two-step sign-in.

web/src/routes/users/useSetPassword.ts.name: Reset password logic
web/src/routes/users/useSetPassword.ts.description: Holds the entries and saving steps behind the reset-password pop-up.

web/src/routes/UsersPage.tsx.name: Staff users page
web/src/routes/UsersPage.tsx.description: Lists everyone with an account and lets an owner add workers or admins and open the pop-ups to change their details, role, password, flock access and status.
